title: Code structure and input
narration: The project separates crawling, cleaning, extraction, and orchestration. The input is a JSON array containing the three assignment targets: Postman, Supabase, and Vapi. The README explains environment setup and local execution.

title: Execute the Python pipeline
narration: I am starting the command with NVIDIA and the free tier only guard enabled. This terminal displays the actual process output. The three companies are processed concurrently, using headless Chromium to render their public websites.

title: Clean context before extraction
narration: The crawler discovers relevant company links. The cleaner removes scripts, styles, SVG elements, and navigation boilerplate. It preserves readable text, public emails, and profile associations. The bounded context sent to the language model contains clean evidence, not raw HTML trees.

title: Strict structured outputs
narration: Pydantic defines the required overview, target audience, contacts, leadership details, and confidence score. The overview must contain two sentences. Confidence is bounded from zero to one. The extractor checks the schema and verifies that reported entities have supporting evidence.
